description: Manually maintained benchmark snapshot and platform supplement data for the Frontier Models dimension. Update this file when new Arena snapshots or Epoch AI exports are available.
update_notes: Initial V3 seed. Arena snapshot approximate Q1 2026. Epoch AI snapshot April 2026. ModelScope supplement is an estimated lower bound.

lmsys_arena.coverage_note: Arena ranks only models submitted for public human evaluation. Some frontier models run API-only and may not be submitted. Chinese models relying on domestic APIs may be structurally underrepresented relative to their actual capability.

epoch_ai_output.coverage_note: Epoch AI applies a documented selection methodology for 'notable' models. Chinese lab models with limited English documentation or closed weights may be excluded. This creates a systematic undercount of China's model output relative to the raw volume on ModelScope.

modelscope_supplement.description: Estimated 30-day model publication activity by Chinese labs that publish primarily on ModelScope (魔搭社区) and are not fully captured by Hugging Face Hub tracking. This is a conservative lower-bound estimate, not an API-derived count.
modelscope_supplement.coverage_note: ModelScope (Alibaba) is the dominant Chinese model platform with 100k+ hosted models. Labs already tracked via HF (Qwen, DeepSeek, THUDM, etc.) are NOT double-counted here. This supplement captures estimated activity from labs with limited HF presence.

labs.name: BAAI (Beijing Academy of AI)
labs.notes: FlagAI, FlagEmbedding, AquilaChat series. Primarily ModelScope distribution.

labs.name: Baichuan Intelligence
labs.notes: Baichuan2, Baichuan3 series. Significant domestic platform presence.

labs.name: Kuaishou AI
labs.notes: Kling video generation, Kolors image models. Primarily domestic distribution.

labs.name: Vivo AI / BlueLM
labs.notes: BlueLM on-device series. Primarily ModelScope distribution.

modelscope_supplement.methodology_note: Estimates are based on observed ModelScope activity patterns from public pages and prior monitoring. These numbers should be treated as directional, not precise. A proper ModelScope API integration would replace this supplement.

ecosystem_breadth.description: Platform distribution scores estimating each country's open-model reach across HuggingFace (global) and ModelScope (China-primary). Scored as US% / China% share of combined.

hf_downloads.source: Hugging Face Hub API (from diffusion pipeline)
hf_downloads.coverage_note: US open-source models (Llama series, Stable Diffusion, Phi) dominate HF global downloads. Chinese model HF downloads come primarily from Qwen and DeepSeek.

modelscope_presence.coverage_note: Chinese labs dominate ModelScope. US labs (Meta, Microsoft) have limited ModelScope presence relative to their HF footprint. Estimate based on top-1000 model list composition.

platform_weights.rationale: HF weighted higher as it represents global reach. ModelScope weighted at 0.45 to reflect its large but primarily China-domestic distribution.
